French Woman to Sue Over Unauthorized Use of Nude Photos in Book Promotion

French feminist icon Gisèle Pelicot is "deeply shocked" and plans to pursue legal action against a publisher and author after nude photographs of her were used without her consent to promote a psychoanalyst's book. The images were reportedly sent out to publicize the book, which suggests Pelicot was complicit. Pelicot, who became a symbol against sexual violence during rape trials against her husband and others in 2024, stated she will take legal action.
